sn42.11:1.3: While this might seem like a generic question, the phrase “origin and disappearance of suffering” appears rarely elsewhere, in the context of dependent origination ([sn12.43:1.2](), [sn35.106:1.1]()). It is unusual to see an obscure lay person directly asking on this topic. The Buddha’s response shows that he did not think Bhadraka would understand the explanation of this given elsewhere, in terms of the arising of sense activity leading to continuation of rebirth. But rather than dismissing the problem as too hard, he takes an approach that Bhadraka can relate to.
